flags.message: The frozen distribution_count of 1 counts the Jul 8 distribution for the Sep 28 conference, which the Jul 27 call for a response superseded before the petition was considered. The forthcoming redistribution after the Sep 9 reply will resolve relist-increment as a relist although it is the petition's first real consideration. Also, the sal-v4 band is `baseline` despite the call for a response, so the scored baseline understates this docket's observed signal; noted for the banding feature set, not as an error in this cell.
